chapter_title: Concerning the Interpretation of the Fourteen [Gre
spiritual_reading:
Know that, in the lower degrees, every state there is held within a complete ordering of all things. There is a sufficient series of fundamental falsities and their derivative operations, together with a twofold proceeding of influx and reception in the outer person. Divine love consecrates and vivifies these workings within their vessels, so that what is there is brought into a full process: what is sufficient in operation conjoined with the marriage of willing and understanding.

There is also a full ordering of the powers that sustain the whole effect of the lower created order, together with the two principal origins from which those powers proceed. This is the complete acknowledgment that has been uttered: a form of worship made complete by a full measure of supplications, through which the lower created order is held in connection and stability.

There are complete interior states of wisdom and love; and the inner church has spoken concerning them in its confession, because they are set forth within the doctrine that lies concealed from the external person. That concealed doctrine is made firm. It endured the assault of evil, and nothing in the opposing force could prevail against it. There is an interior fullness hidden within these things.

Therefore Divine truth proceeding from Divine good was sent forth; it descended and established itself with power in the midst of these ordered states. It is called the beneficent origin of all interior states and holy truths that are conjoined into one. It became the leader and governing wisdom in the created order, according to the pattern of the Divine itself, which is the source and ruler of all orderly dispositions. The whole of the lower created order is held together by the consent of their conjoined love and understanding, even to the completion of the process.

fills.notes: The list that follows totals seven (five elements + Call + Hearing). In the oldest layer these are counted as ‘praises’ or ordered acknowledgments residing in the fourteen aeons; ¶4 resumes explicitly with ‘fourteen praises’.
The fourteen here are the full interior ‘measures’ or heavens of Light within which the sevens abide; the register is cosmological, not devotional.
Carries forward the parallel structure: after the seven below, ‘also’ introduces the sustaining powers above/beneath as another complete ordering.

fills.fill: of the great aeons of light
fills.notes: Matches the chapter’s constant ‘fourteen aeons’ framework: a complete interior ordering in Light before the mention of Seth’s confession.

fills.fill: in the land that is not revealed
fills.notes: The ‘unrevealed land’ is the hidden doctrine or interior church in the spiritual translation; the phrase completes the sense that they are ‘explained’ within what is concealed.

fills.fill: which is established and made firm
fills.notes: The spiritual translation stresses that the concealed doctrine ‘is made firm’; the substrate idiom is establishing the hidden land as a stable ordering.
Corresponds to ‘nothing in the opposing force could prevail’; here expressed as the enemy having no equal to these ordered states.
Introduces the ‘hidden plenitude’ as an interior fullness residing within these states, consistent with the correspondential ‘interior fullness hidden within these things’.
Sets up the descent of the Ambassador/Divine Truth: ‘the hidden plenitude … sent forth the Ambassador’. This matches the spiritual translation’s ‘was sent forth’.

Oldest-layer functional title for the envoy proceeding from the Father: Divine truth proceeding from Divine good. ‘Living Word’ fits the impersonal cosmological register better than later ecclesial titles.

fills.fill: and their counsel and their thought are one
fills.notes: The universe is held together by their will; correspondentially this is the conjunction of love and understanding acting as a single consent. The fill articulates the inner unity that grounds the ‘will’ maintaining order to the end.

assessment: Most lacunae are either trivial letter-joins or tightly constrained by the chapter’s fixed numeration (seven within fourteen) and by the later explicit phrases ‘fourteen praises’ and ‘unrevealed land’. The harder gaps are in ¶5 where the mythic envoy-title and the exact phrasing around ‘hidden plenitude’ are not recoverable from syntax alone; those were restored by correspondential function (interior fullness sending forth proceeding truth) in the oldest cosmological register.
